note: One of the most contested division votes of the 18th Lok Sabha. No party-line rebels recorded — TDP and JDU support was decisive for the government majority.
details: The division was called after the Opposition demanded a recorded vote. All 288 Ayes were from NDA and allied parties. The 232 Noes came from INDIA bloc parties including INC, SP, TMC, and AAP.

rebels.name: Kapil Sibal
rebels.note: Voted against on constitutional grounds — challenged the District Collector oversight provision as undermining judicial review.

note: Rajya Sabha sat until 4 AM. One notable rebel vote recorded — Kapil Sibal (Independent) voted against.
details: The Rajya Sabha vote was closer than in Lok Sabha. The government relied on NDA allies including AIADMK, TDP, and independent members to cross the majority threshold.

note: Division called by Opposition after 12-hour debate. No rebel votes recorded. Government comfortable majority maintained.
details: The Finance Bill 2026 passed with a comfortable majority after extensive debate. All amendments proposed by the Opposition were defeated on division.

rebels.name: Manish Tewari
rebels.note: Abstained citing constituency-level concerns about gram sabha empowerment provisions potentially conflicting with existing state panchayat laws.

rebels.name: Imran Pratapgarhi
rebels.note: Abstained — did not provide a public statement.

note: Two INC members abstained against party position, one SP member abstained. The 1 AM passage was contested with opposition walkout before the final division.
details: The opposition walked out before the vote was called, returning only to register dissent. Three abstentions were recorded — an unusual occurrence suggesting some cross-party unease with specific provisions.
